page_note: Page contains two chapter units. First (seg 0-23): cosmological question and exposition about how the Wheel turns within the heavens without piercing them, with the lion/ship/figurehead analogy — strong substrate teaching. Second (seg 24-35): opens new chapter on "rich god and angel," beginning with cosmological question. Heavy lacunae (50% damage). The dialogue-frame attribution must be stripped at seg 2, 7, 27, 31, 33; the substantive cosmological questions (seg 3-6, 28-30) and answers (seg 8-23) constitute the substrate.
